headline: Blues recall Logan Mailloux from conditioning assignment ahead of potential season debut
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that the Blues have recalled Logan Mailloux from his conditioning assignment ahead of a potential season debut. Mailloux suffered a hand injury during a fight in the preseason, per the same report.

The timing matters less for Mailloux himself than for what St. Louis looks like right now. The Blues are 7-7-2 with 16 points through 16 games, and our numbers say that record is about right. They've earned 49 percent of the expected goals so far this season (expected goals measure the quality of chances), which is slightly below even. Their goaltending has covered for that: goals saved above expected, which compares the goals a goalie allowed with what the shots should have produced, sits at +2.5. Meanwhile their skaters have scored 0.6 goals fewer than the chances suggest. A team that gets slightly outplayed and leans on its goalie has little margin for error, so any lineup help matters. We'd watch whether the five-on-five share, 48 percent so far this season, tilts toward even once he's in the lineup.
